1.content: Build comprehensive Admin Panel with user and credit management
1.details:
Create admin dashboard with:
- User account management (create, edit, delete client accounts)
- Credit allocation system (assign credits to clients)
- System analytics and monitoring
- Database management tools
- Admin authentication and role-based access

2.details:
Build agent management system similar to the image:
- Agent cards display with performance metrics
- Add/edit/deploy agents functionality
- Agent capability configuration
- Performance monitoring and analytics
- Agent status management (active/inactive)
- Integration with available tools and APIs

3.details:
Develop client-facing user panel:
- User registration and authentication
- Credit balance display and usage tracking
- Task history and results
- Agent selection and interaction interface
- Subscription management
- User profile management

4.details:
Create comprehensive role management:
- Admin roles (super admin, system admin, support)
- Client roles (enterprise, business, individual)
- Permission-based access control
- Role assignment and management interface
- Audit trail for role changes

5.details:
Comprehensive testing of all management features:
- Admin panel functionality testing
- Credit allocation and tracking
- Agent deployment and management
- User workflow end-to-end testing
- API integration verification
